resources.string: Your cycle. Your connection. Your data.
Your entries stay on your own server and are shared only according to your choices.
Lunara is not a medical device or a contraceptive. Predictions are estimates.

Enter the regular HTTPS address. If the server provides a dedicated header-auth address, you may enter https://user:app-password@your-server.example once. Lunara then separates and encrypts those credentials.
Allow insecure HTTP in local development mode
HTTP sends data without encryption and may only be used in a trusted development environment.
Changing servers permanently erases all local cycle data, pending changes, credentials, and server sessions on this device. Entries that have not synced will be lost.
Scan a Lunara server QR code. QR codes containing credentials will be rejected.
This QR code contains credentials and was rejected for security.
Set up Lunara for the first time
Only for the very first tracker account on a completely empty server. The token is available only in the local server configuration. Afterwards, access uses sign-in or an invitation.

Changes your personal Lunara password and revokes every other Lunara server session.
This means your personal Lunara password. Other Lunara server sessions are revoked. Data already stored offline remains on those devices.
The new password must be 8–128 characters long. Uppercase letters, numbers, and special characters are not required.
The new password must differ from the current password.

Shown only after at least three complete cycles and disabled in special modes.
Enable the optional fertility estimate first. Without it, no fertility data is calculated or shared.
Lunara calculates an uncertain range from past calendar data only. It does not detect ovulation, establish pregnancy, and must never be used for contraception.
Create a single-use invitation code. It remains valid until it is used or you revoke it and contains neither a password nor server credentials.
Valid until it is used or you revoke the invitation.
An invitation is active. For security, its code is shown only immediately after creation.
QR code for invitation %1$s. It only contains the invitation code.
Tips may consider explicitly shared symptoms without revealing private details in the tip text.
Enable “Share symptoms” first. Symptoms that are not shared must never influence tips.
By default, Partner B only sees the estimated range. More information becomes visible only after an explicit choice.
These personal preferences guide respectful partner tips. They do not share any additional health data.
